title: zoneinfo — IANA time zone support — Python 3.14.8 documentation
snippet: The zoneinfo module provides a concrete time zone implementation to support the IANA time zone database as originally specified in PEP 615. By default, zoneinfo uses the system’s time zone data if available; if no system time zone data is available, the library will fall back to using the first-party tzdata package available on PyPI.

title: Python zoneinfo Module - W3Schools
snippet: The zoneinfo module provides support for IANA time zone database, allowing you to work with time zones in a standard and reliable way. Use it to convert between time zones, handle daylight saving time transitions, and work with historical time zone data.

title: tzdata: Python package providing IANA time zone data
snippet: In addition to the zoneinfo files, it also provides a small amount of extra metadata about the time zones. The tzdata.zones file is a newline-delimited file listing all the IANA keys for time zone files present in the tzdata.zoneinfo package.
